name: Redbooth
description_en:
Redbooth is hosted team project-management software built around workspaces and tasks. A workspace collects the work, files and discussion for a project; board, list and Timeline views give different ways to inspect the same tasks. Reports add a view across projects and people, with entitlements that vary by plan.

A useful evaluation follows a request from intake to assignment, discussion, completion and a client-visible update. The public pages now document web forms, public task links and an OAuth MCP connection alongside the core task workflow. These paths have different audiences and write permissions. This profile explains those differences from documentation, without claiming an account, AI or integration test.
description_zh:
Redbooth 是以工作区和任务为基础的托管团队项目管理软件。工作区汇集一个项目的工作、文件和讨论；看板、列表与 Timeline 以不同方式查看同一组任务。报告进一步呈现跨项目、跨人员信息，具体权益随套餐变化。

有效评估可以跟踪请求从进入、分派、讨论、完成到客户可见更新的全过程。公开页面现已记录网页表单、公开任务链接和 OAuth MCP 连接，以及核心任务流程。这些路径的受众和写入权限不同。本文依据文档解释差别，没有声称实际测试账户、AI 或集成。

core_features.explanation_zh: 把标题／详情映射到所选任务列表及可选负责人。

core_features.explanation_en: Share one task, including comments, and revoke sharing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 共享包含评论的一项任务，并可撤销共享。

core_features.explanation_en: A compatible authorized client can read and write tasks.
core_features.explanation_zh: 兼容且已授权的客户端可以读写任务。

en: Triage a client design request and share a reviewed read-only status link.
zh: 分诊客户设计请求，并共享经审阅的只读状态链接。
use_cases.basis: Proposed workflow, not an executed customer outcome.

Deployment.en: Hosted web service with mobile apps; remote MCP is a separate authorized client path.
Deployment.zh: 托管网页服务及移动应用；远程 MCP 是另行授权的客户端路径。

steps.en: Create a small workspace with triage, active and completed work; test one request’s fields and owner.
steps.zh: 创建含分诊、进行中和已完成工作的小工作区，测试一条请求的字段及负责人。

steps.en: Review the full comment thread, inspect a logged-out public link and test revocation.
steps.zh: 审阅完整评论线程，检查退出登录的公开链接视图，并测试撤销。

integrations.scope: Hosted OAuth MCP documented; live authorization, write retries and assistant-client eligibility not tested.

items.en: Deleted tasks cannot be recovered; resolved tasks can be reopened.
items.zh: 删除任务不可恢复，已完成任务可重新打开。

items.en: Public task views include comments and need review before sharing.
items.zh: 公开任务视图包含评论，共享前需审阅。

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.

sections.title_en: Map a client request to an accountable task
sections.title_zh: 把客户请求映射成有责任人的任务
sections.en:
On Business/Enterprise, a web form belongs to a workspace. Its short field becomes the task title, the details field becomes the description, and submissions enter a chosen list with an optional assignee. Submitters do not need accounts. Deleting the form disables its link while preserving tasks already created.

For a hypothetical design revision, label the form around the requested change and needed context, route it to a triage list, and verify one submission’s title, description and owner. Treat the thank-you screen as acknowledgement, not a delivery promise. The form guide does not establish deduplication, spam handling or an email response workflow.
sections.zh:
Business／Enterprise 的网页表单属于一个工作区，短字段成为任务标题，详情字段成为描述；提交进入所选列表，并可指定负责人。提交人无需账户。删除表单会使链接失效，但已创建任务保留。

假设处理设计修改，可以按所需变化和背景设置标签，导入分诊列表，并核对一条提交的标题、描述和负责人。感谢页面表示收到，不能当作交付承诺。表单指南未确立去重、垃圾提交处理或邮件回复流程。

sections.title_en: A public task link also exposes its comments
sections.title_zh: 公开任务链接也展示评论
sections.en:
Public links on Pro and above show one task read-only without an account. The documented view includes description, subtasks, dates, assignee and comments. Organization admins and the workspace creator can create the link and later stop sharing.

Review the comment thread before sharing a client revision: internal discussion may be part of the public view. Inspect the link as a logged-out visitor, then verify that Stop sharing ends access. A public link is for reading; an external user is the separate collaboration path when someone needs to update work. No link or external account was created here.
sections.zh:
Pro 及以上的公开链接无需账户即可只读查看一项任务。文档视图包含描述、子任务、日期、负责人和评论；组织管理员及工作区创建者可创建链接，之后停止共享。

共享客户修改任务前，应先审阅评论线程，内部讨论可能也在公开视图中。建议以退出登录的访客检查链接，再确认 Stop sharing 后无法访问。公开链接用于阅读；需要更新工作时，外部用户是另一条协作路径。本次没有创建链接或外部账户。

sections.title_en: Distinguish the Timeline from subtask date rules
sections.title_zh: 区分 Timeline 与子任务日期规则
sections.en:
Timeline edits reflect back into tasks and task edits into the Timeline. Gantt visibility does not establish every scheduling rule: dependency links start on Pro, while independent subtask owners and dates start on Business.

The subtask guide describes a prompt to shift dated subtasks when a parent date changes. It excludes undated subtasks and says a subtask date before the new parent due date will not shift. Test examples on both sides of that condition before relying on bulk rescheduling. For the revision sample, move the parent by two days and inspect each dated step; do not infer automatic date creation.
sections.zh:
Timeline 编辑会反映到任务，任务编辑也反映到 Timeline。能够查看 Gantt 不代表具备所有排程规则：依赖链接从 Pro 开始，独立子任务负责人和日期从 Business 开始。

子任务指南说明，父任务日期改变后，会提示是否移动已有日期的子任务；未定日期的子任务除外，并称早于父任务新截止日期的子任务不会移动。依赖批量重排前，应测试该条件两侧的例子。对于修改样例，可以把父任务推迟两天并逐项检查，不能推断会自动补充日期。

sections.title_en: Recorded hours are separate from task completion
sections.title_zh: 记录工时与完成任务分开判断
sections.en:
The time guide uses hh:mm for estimates and logged work. An estimate is entered beside the due-date controls. Actual time is added through a comment with the Time Spent control; the display compares accumulated time with the estimate. The commercial feature page distinguishes Pro time logging from Business estimates.

For a hypothetical six-hour estimate with two ninety-minute work entries, recorded time is three hours. That arithmetic does not prove the deliverable is half complete or half its quality checks have passed. Keep the acceptance criteria in the task and review time corrections separately before relying on a client report. This example was not entered in an account.
sections.zh:
工时指南对估算和实际记录都使用 hh:mm。估算从截止日期附近设置，实际时间通过评论中的 Time Spent 输入；界面比较累计工时与估算。商业功能页把 Pro 工时记录和 Business 估算区分。

假设估算六小时，记录两次各九十分钟工作，则已记录三小时。这个算术不能证明交付完成一半，或质量检查通过一半。应把验收标准写在任务中，客户报告使用工时前单独审阅修正。本次没有在账户输入该样例。

sections.title_en: Investigate an email bounce and resolve finished work
sections.title_zh: 排查邮件退回，完成后使用 resolve
sections.en:
Each workspace has a task-creation email address. The help guide says unrecognized sender addresses bounce, accepted messages create tasks in Inbox, and supported tokens can assign or resolve work. A missing email-created task should therefore be checked against the sending account and target workspace before repeated forwarding.

Resolve marks work complete while preserving it for search and reopening. Delete is restricted to workspace admins or the creator and is documented as unrecoverable. For recurring client work, verify the completed item remains findable rather than deleting it to clear the list. No message was sent and no task was deleted for this review.
sections.zh:
每个工作区有任务创建邮箱。帮助指南说明，无法识别的发件地址会被退回；接受的邮件会在 Inbox 创建任务，并支持分派或完成的标记。因此，邮件任务缺失时，应先检查发信账户和目标工作区，再考虑重复转发。

Resolve 标记完成，并保留搜索和重新打开能力。Delete 仅工作区管理员或创建者可执行，文档明确不可恢复。对于重复客户工作，应确认完成项仍可找到，避免通过删除清空列表。本次没有发送邮件或删除任务。

sections.title_en: AI suggestions and an acting connector are different paths
sections.title_zh: 区分 AI 建议与可执行连接器
sections.en:
The Business task menu offers title trimming, subtask suggestions and summaries based on task context. Review generated text against the brief and comments before adoption. Suggestions do not independently verify a deadline, and the pricing table’s “coming soon” project status should not be treated as an available feature.

The MCP service is a hosted endpoint using OAuth and can read/create/update tasks. Its setup requires a compatible client and an authorized Redbooth account. For a pilot, request one clearly identified task with an explicit workspace, owner and date, then inspect the stored result. Review client permissions and check for an existing task before repeating an uncertain write. No connector was authorized here.
sections.zh:
Business 任务菜单提供精简标题、子任务建议，以及依据任务背景的摘要。采用生成文字前，应对照简报和评论检查。建议不能独立验证截止日期；定价表中的“coming soon”项目状态功能也不能当作现已可用。

MCP 服务是采用 OAuth 的托管端点，可读取／创建／更新任务。设置需要兼容客户端和获授权的 Redbooth 账户。试点可要求创建一项带明确工作区、负责人和日期的任务，再检查存储结果。应审阅客户端权限，不确定写入是否成功时，重复前先查现有任务。本次没有授权连接器。

sections.title_en: Calculate seats and check downgrade limits
sections.title_zh: 计算席位并检查降级上限
sections.en:
Free permits two users, two workspaces and 2 GB storage. The public annual USD rates are Pro USD 9 and Business USD 15 per user/month; monthly rates are USD 12 and USD 18.75. A five-seat Pro example is USD45/month equivalent with annual billing, before any purchase-specific charges. Confirm checkout and tax conditions. Everyone in one subscription uses the same plan.

The fourteen-day Business trial needs no card. Moving to Free requires reducing the account to its limits even though the page says project history stays. Plan an export and retention check before removing excess work. The terms describe advance billing and no refunds unless stated otherwise, and require written permission to duplicate or resell the service. Self-hosting and an open-source license were not established.
sections.zh:
Free 允许两位用户、两个工作区和 2GB 存储。公开美元年付费率为 Pro 每用户每月 9、Business 15；月付分别为 12 和 18.75。五席位 Pro 年付相当于每月 45 美元，未计具体购买附加项，应核对结账和税费。同一订阅中的所有人使用同一套餐。

十四天 Business 试用无需银行卡。即使页面说明项目历史保留，转为 Free 仍需把账户降到其上限。移除超额工作前，应规划导出和保留核对。条款说明预先计费、无另行说明时不退款，复制或转售服务需书面许可。本次未确立自托管或开源许可。
